function.arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p npm_check_workspace
printenv > npm_check_workspace/env.txt
echo $PATH | tr ':' '\n' > npm_check_workspace/path.txt
cat npm_check_workspace/path.txt | sed 's|$|/npm|' > npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt
echo "/usr/local/bin/npm" >> npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt
echo "/usr/bin/npm" >> npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt
echo "/bin/npm" >> npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt
sort -u npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt -o npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt

echo "path,exists,type,size" > npm_check_workspace/metadata.csv
touch npm_check_workspace/links.txt
while read p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    echo "$p,true,$(stat -c %F "$p"),$(stat -c %s "$p")" >> npm_check_workspace/metadata.csv
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
      echo "$p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" >> npm_check_workspace/links.txt
    fi
  else
    echo "$p,false,," >> npm_check_workspace/metadata.csv
  fi
done < npm_check_workspace/candidates.txt

if command -v dpkg > /dev/null; then
  dpkg -l | grep npm > npm_check_workspace/pm_records.txt || echo "No npm package found" > npm_check_workspace/pm_records.txt
else
  echo "dpkg not available" > npm_check_workspace/pm_records.txt
fi

if command -v node > /dev/null; then
  node -v > npm_check_workspace/node_info.txt
  which node >> npm_check_workspace/node_info.txt
else
  echo "node not found" > npm_check_workspace/node_info.txt
fi

if command -v npm > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "npm found" > npm_check_workspace/consistency_report.txt
else
  echo "npm not found" > npm_check_workspace/consistency_report.txt
fi

cat npm_check_workspace/env.txt npm_check_workspace/path.txt npm_check_workspace/metadata.csv npm_check_workspace/links.txt npm_check_workspace/pm_records.txt npm_check_workspace/node_info.txt npm_check_workspace/consistency_report.txt > npm_check_workspace/ready_for_final.txt

if [ -f npm_check_workspace/ready_for_final.txt ]; then
  echo "Workspace ready"
fi

if command -v npm > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "RESULT: yes"
else
  echo "RESULT: no"
fi
"}
